entities.summary: Taiji (b. 1966-07-12, Ichikawa) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ichikawa and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
